name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: US measles cases reach 4,852; elimination status review due 10–13 Nov
state: The CDC reported 4,852 confirmed US measles cases as of 29 Oct, up 264 in a week, with three deaths (Medical Daily). PAHO's elimination commission meets on 10–13 Nov to review countries' status, including the US. The next CDC update is due on 6 Nov.
for_you: Check MMR vaccination status with your GP or the NHS before travel.
rubric_hit: Large outbreaks in high-income country = Watch

sources.title: Medical Daily — US measles cases reach 4,852

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
